name: Hydra: Sequentially-Dependent Draft Heads for Medusa Decoding (arXiv:2402.05109)
notes: arXiv v2 (Oct 2024). Proposes sequentially-dependent draft heads for Medusa-style decoding, improving over standard independent draft heads. Hydra++ improves decoding throughput by up to 1.31x and 2.70x compared to Medusa decoding and autoregressive decoding respectively. Code at https://github.com/zankner/Hydra. No venue listed on arXiv; likely preprint.
